messages.content: Stay in Baixa/Chiado for its central, walkable location, and try pastéis de nata (or bacalhau à Brás if you prefer something savory).

Stay in Baixa/Chiado, Lisbon's central district. It's walkable to major sights, restaurants and nightlife, and it has excellent metro, tram and train connections, so it suits a short weekend. Alfama is a good alternative if you prefer a mor…[269 chars]

Try pastéis de nata, Lisbon's famous custard tarts, ideally warm from a bakery like Pastéis de Belém. If you want something savory, bacalhau à Brás (shredded salted cod with eggs and potatoes) is a classic local dish.
